changed_factors: Introduce Scale- & Distortion-Aware Moving Prototype Flow (SMPF, critic_formulation='smpf', prior_regularizer='smpf', preset 'smpf'), adapting s-means (Kocabay, Yuksel & Yalcin, 2026; https://suayptalha.github.io/s-means-blog/) to ParticleGAN's clock-free online prototype framework: replace EMPF's 1D rank initialization and count-only fixed-epsilon prototype splitting with 4-round deterministic D^1.5 coreset seeding, tiled addmm nearest-prototype assignment across vector and compact image domains (dim <= 256), online per-prototype distortion EMA (sse_ema) and inter-cluster per-feature variance (feat_scale) driving distortion x usage^0.35 anisotropic RMS revival, and progressive settling-weighted Empirical-Bayes count-adaptive centroid shrinkage (eb_tau = 0.20).

Couple the s-means Empirical-Bayes prototype bank (C_eb, w, ell_proto) directly to generator training via SMPFGANLoss: combine shift-invariant centered adversarial log-odds with thermally matched, Kantorovich-Hellinger slack-screened physical Born-Infeld s-means prototype Sinkhorn divergence, Laguerre power-diagram Monge outlier pull, and per-prototype RMS distortion shells, Nadaraya-Watson detrended coordinate-whitened multi-scale IMQ conditional fiber transport, coordinate-whitened AE reconstruction, and H_0-connected simplicial manifold chord/barycenter + geodesic MDS chart alignment on zero-sigma ParticlePrior codebooks.

Replace EMPF's isotropic eigenvalue-equality prior regularizer terms with SMPFPriorRegularizer's per-coordinate feature-variance-whitened k-NN log-repulsion and RMS dead-particle revival tether while preserving initial-moment envelopes and small-codebook non-collision hinges.
mechanism_rationale: In empf-v8, the online e-means prototype bank suffered from four structural bottlenecks identified in s-means (https://suayptalha.github.io/s-means-blog/): (1) 1D projection seeding missed off-axis and rare 2% clusters on initialization, (2) count-only prototype revival with fixed split_eps=1e-3 split dense narrow clusters while ignoring high-distortion anisotropic/broad clusters, (3) unshrunk rare-cluster means jittered on skewed mixtures, and (4) the prototype bank entered only 5% of the critic chord penalty under loss='non_saturating' and never guided generator transport or compact image/conditional/simplicial domains. SMPF upgrades the bank to clock-free s-means (4-round D^1.5 seeding, tiled addmm assignment, sse_ema x usage^0.35 anisotropic RMS revival across d >= 1, and Empirical-Bayes tau=0.20 centroid shrinkage) and couples (C_eb, w, ell_proto) directly into generator training via scale-invariant physical Born-Infeld prototype Sinkhorn divergence + RMS distortion shells, affine-detrended whitened conditional fiber transport, and H_0-connected simplicial chord alignment.
